text: The User Interface Designer will design a menu for all functions.

The ID Designer will specify which functions belong in the LCD-screen menu.
The UI Designer will provide a map showing all functions and pages for the LCD screen.

The Marketing/ME will propose LED indicator lighting under buttons to show active functions.
The UI and ID designers will finalize navigation controls, including a menu button, four arrows, OK/back, and how to access the LCD screen menu.

The team will consolidate the layout and function groupings into the LCD and remote design for the next review.
